description: This file contains the implementation of the PaymentAddress controller class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages actions related to checkout payment address, including displaying address forms, saving address data, and retrieving address details via AJAX calls.

classes.name: PaymentAddress
classes.description: Controller class handling the checkout payment address functionalities including display, save, and retrieval of address data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the payment address form with existing customer addresses and necessary data for the checkout process.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST request to save or update the customer's payment address, validating input fields, creating new addresses if needed, and updating session data.

methods.name: address
methods.description: AJAX method to retrieve the details of a specific address based on address_id, primarily used to load address data dynamically during checkout.
